segments.text: Two weeks earlier, in Sydney, Phillip Hughes was batting on sixty-three, when a bouncer hit him on the neck. Two days later, he was gone. He was twenty-five.

segments.text: Now the first Test of the summer comes to Adelaide. The ground he called home.
segments.caption: Now the first Test of the summer comes to Adelaide. The ground he called home.

segments.text: Before a ball is bowled, the whole ground rises, and claps, for sixty-three seconds.

segments.text: Day one. Australia bat. They wear black armbands, and four-oh-eight, Hughes's Test cap number, on their shirts.
